project_type: Browser-based Visual Novel using vanilla HTML/CSS/JS with a custom engine
language: JavaScript (ES6+, no modules, globals via window.*)
build_system: None - static files served directly. No build step required.
test_framework: Python scripts: tests/test_walk.py (static scene graph walker, no dependencies) and tests/test_vn.py (Playwright runtime test requiring a local server)
build_command: No build needed. Open index.html directly.
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3 tests/test_walk.py to verify all scenes are reachable and all endings are accessible. 2. Open index.html in a browser and manually test affected features (save/load, backlog, control bar). 3. Check for JS syntax errors by loading the page.
setup_instructions: No setup needed. The game is pure static HTML/CSS/JS.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. No package managers needed. Python3 available for running test_walk.py. Playwright would need installation for test_vn.py but test_walk.py is the primary static validation.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns: IIFE modules (window.Engine, window.UI, etc.), scene data as window.SCENES properties, step-based scene format. Keep the author's writing tone as described in README.md.
key_patterns: Engine uses step-based scenes with types: say, narration, thought, choice, if, goto, set, ending. Characters defined in CHARACTERS object. Flags stored in Engine state. Save system uses localStorage with PREFIX gfh_save_. UI is IIFE pattern returning public API. Backlog stored in Engine state.backlog array. Scenes use { type: 'if', flag: 'x', op: '>=', value: N, then: 'scene_id' } for branching. Character names displayed via charDef.name in doSay().
directory_structure: Root: index.html (entry), css/ (main.css, ui.css), js/ (engine.js, ui.js, save.js, game.js, audio.js), data/ (characters.js, locations.js, endings.js), data/scenes/ (prologue + ch01-ch11 + branches), tests/ (test_walk.py, test_vn.py), lore/ (source manuscripts)
